$comment: site.footer.columns holds one column with no title: a single flat menu, as WordPress has (SC-006). The markup says its list 'takes the nav's name' but declares only aria-labelledby (when the column has a title), so the untitled list carries no naming attribute of its own and the nav's aria-label names the region (reported). site.logo.light names a media id; no dark logo is set, so the link carries no data-swaps. The logo is drawn at site.logoHeight 40.
summary: A single flat menu as one untitled column, on the surface-inverse tone, with the light logo in the brand block, the copyright line and the consent control, and no socials.
